method: Planar fixed-frame mesh with area error and Sargent shape/scale distortion costs
limit: Independent planar experiment, not the paper sphere or hybrid implementation. Reference triangles use Equal Earth planar geometry, not spherical geometry. Fixed frame and nearest-land water scale differ from the paper. Small regions share mesh degrees of freedom. Guide areas can remain inaccurate. No final tile budgets change. Positive triangle areas are checked; output component validity and overlaps must also be checked. No connector paths are added.
